name: @mm/content
description: Validated game content — the grid, its nodes, species, traditions, and effect primitives — plus the hard-failing loader that interns it, and a parallel audio content set (cues, voice-line banks) with its own loader and generation-request planner.
author: Ann Kelner
//: This package MUST NOT gain runtime dependencies. The loader ships a small JSON Schema interpreter (src/json-schema.ts) precisely so that content validation is available wherever the simulation runs, with no install step. A schema validator would only ever be usable as a test-side cross-check.
